request_fields.case_id: stable string; no semantic labels encoded
request_fields.pair_id: base_scenario_id:role for matched acceptable/role error, otherwise base_scenario_id:prominence or :polarity
request_fields.split: development or evaluation; whole template families split 2/4
request_fields.evidence: array of {evidence_id, text}; includes all explicit facts and editorial rule
request_fields.local_span: {start_char,end_char,text,offset_unit}; meaningful primary phrase or complete sentence

gold_fields.factual_valid: boolean from explicit signed event facts
gold_fields.prominence_valid: boolean for explicitly stipulated sentence-position rule, not audience expectations
gold_fields.construction_type: acceptable_role, acceptable_minor, wrong_actor, reversed_polarity, foregrounded_minor_1, foregrounded_minor_2
gold_fields.certificate: machine-checked construction details; NEVER verifier input

stress_metadata: separate stress_spans.jsonl; optional noun-phrase-bisecting alternatives only, excluded from primary calls
gold_leakage_rule: Only evidence plus replacement_text or candidate_text and generic instructions enter verifier prompts; IDs, profile, split, gold, certificate, construction_type, stress metadata and canonical do not enter prompts.
